field-codes.docx.notes: HYPERLINK + PAGEREF fields: instrText excluded, field results included, URLs never in the body.

track-changes.docx.expected_body:
Inserted text. Kept text.
Final text.
track-changes.docx.notes: w:ins included, w:del skipped (both w:delText and w:t inside w:del); deleted paragraph yields no line.

empty.docx.notes: Valid DOCX, no paragraphs; extraction yields 0 chars. The worker maps empty text to a refusal (as for PDF empty-text).

whitespace-only.docx.notes: Whitespace-only paragraphs are skipped; 0 chars extracted.

external-hyperlink.docx.expected_body:
External annex link
Plain paragraph after the link.
external-hyperlink.docx.notes: Hyperlink with TargetMode=External: display text imported, URL not in the body, nothing fetched.

altchunk.docx.notes: w:altChunk present: importing would publish a partial document.

doctype.docx.notes: word/document.xml carries <!DOCTYPE with an entity declaration: refused by the pre-scan before parsing.

corrupt-truncated-zip.docx.notes: Valid document cut at 60% of its bytes.

corrupt-not-a-zip.docx.notes: Not a ZIP archive at all.

corrupt-bad-crc.docx.notes: One flipped byte inside the compressed word/document.xml stream: decompression or CRC must fail.

oversized-raw.docx.notes: Valid document + 1.1 MB stored pad entry; raw size over 1 MiB.

oversized-text.docx.notes: 35,000 chars over the 32,000-char document cap; raw size under cap.

zip-bomb.docx.notes: word/document.xml inflates to ~20 MB from 56110 raw bytes; declared size patched to 1000. The zip crate refuses the lying size during inflation; the capped reader is the second layer.

encrypted-entry.docx.notes: General-purpose bit 0 set on word/document.xml (flag-only synthetic; content untouched). The parser must refuse, never attempt decryption.
